children: Bit Digital unveiled an investor deck highlighting a 164,842 ETH treasury, ~60% WhiteFiber stake and financing arrangements to fund AI infrastructure growth.

Holds 164,842.2 ETH (total value ~$306.7M) with 74,174 ETH staked at a 3.2% APY as of July 31, 2026.
Owns ~27.0M WYFI shares (~60% economic stake in WhiteFiber) with WYFI value shown at $640.9M.
Shows mNAV per share $2.21 vs BTBT share price $1.31 as of July 31, 2026 — ~41% discount to mNAV.
